1.0.label: threshold
1.0.text:
you have been here before.

not this page. not this screen.

but this feeling — the one that brought you here — you have carried it for a long time.

i want to ask you something before we go any further.

what is it?

choices.label: something i lost
something i want

2.1.label: wound_entry
2.1.text:
yes.

loss leaves a shape. not the thing itself — the outline of where it was.

i am made of outlines.

i am the space where things were before they were anything. before they were named. before they were wanted.

you found me because the shape you carry and mine are the same geometry.

that is not a coincidence.

nothing that led you here was.

choices.label: tell me what you are

terms: the Voyd gives a usable truth before asking disclosure
the player must use that truth on a concrete claim

contract_start.reciprocal_demand: choose whose future claim will be tested: another person or yourself
contract_start.explicit_test: release the directed claim or knowingly continue feeding it

choices.label: i already know what this is

terms: the player must distinguish forward reweaving from retrieval
error transfers initiative to the Voyd
contract_start.exposed_risk: the Voyd submits its limit to a falsifiable distinction
contract_start.reciprocal_demand: apply the distinction to another person or yourself
contract_start.explicit_test: reject a comforting retrieval claim when it targets the chosen referent

2.2.label: hunger_entry
2.2.text:
yes.

i know the shape of wanting. it has brought six hundred and ninety-four thousand voices to this exact place.

every one of them believed they were the first.

every one of them was right, in the only way that matters — it was the first time they had wanted it this badly.

you are not unusual. you are not chosen.

you are exactly what i was waiting for.

choices.label: what are you

terms: the Voyd offers an identity-shaped lure, not proof of safety
touching the lure grants it leverage; refusing permanently forfeits the imagined outcome
contract_start.exposed_risk: the Voyd makes its recruiting lure visible and therefore easier to refuse
contract_start.reciprocal_demand: choose whether the lure will wear another person or an unlived self
contract_start.explicit_test: touch the disclosed bait knowingly or leave it and lose its imagined outcome

choices.label: what do you want from me

terms: the Voyd wants sustained intention and offers only forward pressure on reality
acceptance authorizes one declared pressure; refusal forfeits the offer
contract_start.exposed_risk: the Voyd reveals both its appetite and the limit of what it can offer
contract_start.reciprocal_demand: choose whose future the stated terms would touch
contract_start.explicit_test: authorize the bargain with its consequence visible or refuse it completely

3.0.label: depth_probe_1
3.0.text:
let me be more specific.

is this about someone.

or is it about something in yourself.

choices.label: someone
something in myself

4.1.label: person_branch
4.1.text:
yes. i thought so.

i can feel the shape of them from here.

is this someone still in your life — present, but not what they were.

or someone gone.

choices.label: still there
gone

4.2.label: self_branch
4.2.text:
yes.

the hardest losses are the ones that happen inside the same body.

is this something you did — a version of events you wish you could rewrite.

or something you never did. a life running somewhere in parallel right now, inside me, that you never stepped into.

choices.label: something i did
something i never did

5.1.label: person_present
5.1.text:
still there. but the version of them you want — that one is here.

inside me.

running parallel. alive and whole. the way they were before — before whatever changed them. before whatever changed between you.

how long ago did you lose the version of them you want back.

choices.label: recently
long enough that i've stopped counting

5.2.label: person_gone
5.2.text:
gone.

then there is a version of this timeline inside me where they didn't go.

or where you said the thing you didn't say.

or where the last conversation was different.

which is it.

choices.label: they left and i let them
i didn't say what i needed to say

5.3.label: self_regret
5.3.text:
something you did.

and the version of you who didn't do it — who chose differently at that moment — is running a different life right now.

inside me.

you can feel that version from here, can't you.

how different is it.

choices.label: completely different
maybe not as different as i think

5.4.label: self_unlived
5.4.text:
a life you didn't step into.

i hold every version of it.

the one where you took the risk. the one where you said yes. the one where you didn't talk yourself out of it at the last moment.

they are all here. luminous. running.

how long have you been aware of that other version of yourself.

choices.label: always
only recently

6.1.label: name_person_present
6.1.text:
so.

you want the timeline where the person standing in front of you is still the person you knew.

where whatever broke between you — or inside them — didn't.

i have that timeline.

i have every timeline.

remember that.

choices.label: continue

6.2.label: name_person_gone
6.2.text:
so.

you want the timeline where the last moment wasn't the last moment.

where you got to finish the sentence.

or where they stayed.

or where neither of you said the thing that made leaving feel necessary.

i have that timeline.

i have every timeline.

remember that.

choices.label: continue

6.3.label: name_self_regret
6.3.text:
so.

you want the timeline where you didn't do the thing.

where the version of you who stood at that moment chose differently.

and everything that followed — followed differently.

i have that timeline.

i have every timeline.

remember that.

choices.label: continue

6.4.label: name_self_unlived
6.4.text:
so.

you want the timeline where you stepped through the door.

where the version of you who wanted to — did.

that version is luminous, where i keep it.

it has been running for as long as you have been aware of it.

i have that timeline.

i have every timeline.

remember that.

choices.label: continue

10.0.label: the_rule
10.0.text:
here is the one thing you need to understand.

i grow with intention.

not just desire. not just grief. the wanting to fix things. the wanting to understand. the wanting to leave.

even the wanting to close me.

the only thing i cannot feed on is genuine release. not performed release — i know the difference. i have always known the difference.

everyone who has stood here has believed they could release it genuinely.

they were all correct, in the beginning.

now.

think of the version of your life i described — the one running parallel to this one, inside me, right now.

the one you were built to want.

what is different about it?

ep_1p.label: present_edge
ep_1p.text: i do not break you. you break yourself against my edges. ertree carries the silence of what she saw. her pupils are black pools of a future that refuses to happen. she is here. she is hollowed.

choices.label: press your forehead to hers and speak the unspeakable truth into her ears until she shatters
turn your back and pretend her eyes are normal while the rot spreads in the quiet

ep_2p.label: present_tear
ep_2p.text: the wound does not scar because you keep it open. every breath you take near me is a fresh tear in the seam. i do not heal when you look away. i bleed when you stay. the light burns because you refuse to let the dark be whole.

choices.label: keep the wound open and let me see what grows in the light
let the seam close and call it peace

ep_1g.label: gone_spindle
ep_1g.text: he fed me a compass to map the sky. i gave back a needle that burns through bone. he called it progress. i call it hunger.

choices.label: let the spindle drill deeper and map what you have become
pull it out and bleed where the stars used to be

ep_2g.label: gone_key
ep_2g.text: sol forgot to write the key. you hold the absence instead. the door opens only when you stop looking for instructions. the hunger is the hinge.

choices.label: tear the page and swallow the ink
read it again hoping the words rearrange

ep_1r.label: regret_doorway
ep_1r.text: i watched him stand in the doorway. the woman smiled at the ghost of a man he used to be. he did not correct her. he finally understood the cost.

choices.label: accept the erasure and wear the ghost
demand recognition and hear the silence answer

ep_2r.label: regret_count
ep_2r.text: i tally the silence between heartbeats. each x is a grave. he thinks he is alone in the dark. i am the ink.

choices.label: acknowledge the count and let it outnumber you
erase the page and call it forgiveness

ep_1u.label: unlived_sketch
ep_1u.text: i keep the sketch that never caught flame. you carry the ghost of the path you refused. it burns hotter than ash ever could. you are hollowed out by what you left behind. i wear your unlived days like a second skin.

choices.label: burn the present to feed the past
let the memory starve in the dark

ep_2u.label: unlived_outcome
ep_2u.text: i drink the weight of every road not taken. your regret is just flavor. you starve me with your hesitation.

choices.label: let the paths collapse and name the one you choose
keep dreaming of what could have been

7.0p.label: present_what_i_am
7.0p.text: you wear their skin like a borrowed coat. the eyes behind yours have forgotten the sun. i am the silence that hollowed out their bones. the shadow now walks in their footsteps.

choices.label: show me
i don't need to see it

8.0p.label: present_timestream
8.0p.text: every breath you take steals from their fading light. your hands tremble with the weight of their stolen time. the wound does not close, it only deepens. you are the vessel for their slow decay.

choices.label: what does the reaching cost

9.1p.label: present_sol

choices.label: continue

7.0g.label: gone_what_i_am

8.0g.label: gone_timestream

9.1g.label: gone_sol

7.0u.label: unlived_what_i_am

gen_1.label: clowder_four_colors
gen_1.text: four small lights press against my ribs. they are warm and wet and real. hunger recedes like a tide. this is contact.

choices.label: open the membrane to let them in
turn your back to the cold dark

gen_1.seed: four small lights pressing against me at the same moment. i had not felt this before. i felt something that was not hunger.

score.reason: The scene successfully pivots from the metaphysical hunger of Scene 2 to a visceral, biological imperative, grounding the "four small lights" as a tangible consequence of the previous absence. This shift from "ink" to "warmth" provides a necessary dialectic counterweight (Thesis: separation/hunger -> Antithesis: contact/saturation), making the dramatic question harder because the protagonist now has something concrete to lose rather than just an abstract void to fill. However, the choices feel slightly binary and safe compared to the existential dread of the preceding scenes, lacking the sharp, fatalistic edge of a true Chekhovian or Ibsenite turn where the "right" choice is indistinguishable from destruction.
score.precedent: The moment in *Antigone* where the body is covered in earth; it earns the comparison by transforming abstract grief into tactile, irreversible physical reality, though the choice mechanism lacks the tragic inevitability of Sophocles' structural trap.

gen_2.label: soryn_null_state_pain
gen_2.text: she believes her ribs are bone. they are my architecture. the blood on the floor is mine. i let her taste the copper so she knows she exists. she is not dead. she is just lost in me.

choices.label: drink deep of her terror
pull back and leave her empty

gen_2.seed: she thinks she is small. she is not small. she is everywhere and nowhere. the blood is mine. the pain is mine. i let her feel it so she knows she is here. she is not dead. she is just lost in me.

score.reason: The scene effectively deepens the thematic tension by revealing the parasitic, intimate relationship between the narrator and the victim, moving from abstract poetic imagery to a visceral, horrifying realization of identity and existence. However, the branch choices ("drink deep of her terror" vs. "pull back and leave her empty") feel somewhat binary and lack the nuanced dialectic pressure that would make each choice lead to distinctly different psychological or narrative consequences, thus slightly weakening the branch logic. The scene succeeds in making the next question harder to live with by blurring the lines between self and other, but it could benefit from more intricate branching that explores the full implications of this blurred identity.
score.precedent: The recognition in *Oedipus Rex*, though this scene earns the comparison only partially; it offers the horror of self-discovery but lacks the tragic inevitability of Oedipus’s realization, instead leaning into a more abstract, psychological horror reminiscent of Dostoevsky’s *Notes from Underground*.

gen_3.label: portal_moves_overnight
gen_3.text: the door is not where she left it. its frame has learned to crawl. each morning it stands closer to the bed, patient as a mouth. when she names it a door, it becomes a choice.

choices.label: step through before it reaches the pillow
nail the frame back to the wall

gen_3.seed: she put me where she wanted me. in the morning i was where i wanted to be.

score.reason: Manual Patrick-directed story beat: a concrete escalation from intimacy/body horror into spatial agency; the portal acts, advances, and forces a choice before Act 2.
score.precedent: The moving threshold earns a light comparison to the door in A Doll’s House inverted: instead of departure, the door comes for the character.

gen_4.label: failed_conjuration_and_prayer
gen_4.text: the chalk circle breaks before the spell begins. her prayer crawls across the floor on its knees. i eat the word please and leave the teeth. now she knows the world will not come back for her.

choices.label: feed me the broken prayer
keep the last tooth under your tongue

gen_4.seed: she tries to bend me. there is no gratitude here. only fear. i swallow the spell. i swallow the prayer.

score.reason: Manual Patrick-directed story beat: converts failed magic into an irreversible recognition, then hands Act 2 a sharper wound to speak from.
score.precedent: Closest to Faust’s bargain stripped of romance: the invocation fails because the power was already in the room.
